diagnosis: The phase-corrected v2 teacher-state oracle is near the formula floor, but raw model-versus-native gate/current errors resemble exact-formula-versus-native errors. A model-specific attribution cannot be inferred from those raw discrepancies alone.

Per-channel model-minus-formula gate and ionic-current RMSE under the same native voltage.

interpretation: A raw model/native channel error cannot be called a learned-model bottleneck unless the matched model/formula channel error is separately measured. This diagnostic reuses opened data and does not provide independent generalization or a new performance claim.
decision: Task34 v3 is complete only if v2 baseline and current-factorial metrics reproduce within 1e-9 and 1e-12 respectively, all added per-channel model/formula and formula/native probes are finite, and privileged arms remain non-selectable.
